title: Response styles
hint: A style is a short text added to a session's system prompt, so the answers follow a tone or format. A session picks its style; a resumed session keeps it.
builtinHint: Read-only. Copy one to My styles to change it.

default.name: Default
default.description: No extra text: the engine answers its own way.

concise.name: Concise
concise.description: Answer first, only the needed details, no filler.

explain_junior.name: Explain for a junior
explain_junior.description: Plain words, terms defined, concrete examples.

code_review.name: Code review
code_review.description: Verdict first, findings by severity with file and line.

empty: No styles of your own yet.
name: Name
body: Text added to the system prompt
bodyPlaceholder: e.g. Answer in at most five bullet points. No preamble.
deleteMessage: Sessions using it go back to the default style the next time they resume.

errors.nameTooLong: The name is too long (80 characters at most).
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description is too long (300 characters at most).
errors.bodyRequired: Enter the text of the style.
errors.bodyTooLong: The text is too long (8000 characters at most).

projectHint: Styles only this project's sessions can pick, next to the built-in styles and My styles. A session picks its style; a resumed session keeps it.
projectEmpty: This project has no styles of its own yet.
